title: Paloma Business Onboarding Standards: Entry Requirements by Plan
content:
To open a Paloma Business account on a plan, or to move to it, the business must have been operating for the plan's minimum months and must provide the plan's KYB documents; KYB review then takes the plan's review days, counted in Paloma business days once every required document is received. Every plan requires a US-registered business.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Months in business required | 0 | 0 | 3 | 6 | 12 | 24 |
| KYB review (Paloma business days once every required document is received) | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 5 | 7 |

### KYB documents required

| Document | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Scale | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Formation document | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| EIN confirmation | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Beneficial ownership certification | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Owner ID | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Proof of business address | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Business bank statement | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Financial statements | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |

Paloma Business Scale and Paloma Business Enterprise are also entered with a minimum commitment of 12 months.

### Hypothetical reading

A business operating for 8 months meets the months-in-business figure of Paloma Business Starter, Essentials, Growth (3) and Pro (6), and not that of Scale (12) or Enterprise (24).
